mapper.insert: insert into pay_record (pay_id, order_id, record_no, content, status, channel_response, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{payId}, #{orderId}, #{recordNo}, #{content}, #{status}, #{channelResponse}, now(), now(), #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select id, pay_id, order_id, record_no, content, status, channel_response, create_time from pay_record where order_id = #{orderId} order by create_time desc
